claim: By default an account can have at most 25,000 resource associations across all its resource shares in a Region, and this quota is adjustable; a resource included in 10 different resource shares counts 10 against this limit.

evidence.quote: | Maximum number of resource associations across all resource shares in an AWS Region  Each resource included in a resource share counts against this limit. If a resource is included in 10 different resource shares, that counts 10 against the limit.  | 25,000 |
